column1: # E123_CLIPS_v1 — the frozen 64 TACO clips of tables E1–E3 (SharpA · every method · same clips). No re-selection.
# frozen from clips/cand_B0r_random_chordfull.tsv (the B0r random draw; every E1–E3 run uses this list).
# procedure: (1) pool = our canon TACO clips, bundle kind "both", whole sequences (no _tN pieces), sequence in CHORD HF
#   release → 520 clips · 81 (verb,tool,target) triplets. (2) B0 = random.Random(42): shuffle sorted triplets, take the first 64,
#   one clip per triplet = rng.choice(clips of that triplet sorted by name) — no result looked at (script provenance_v1/select_B0_pool.py).
#   (3) B0r: the 10 B0 clips whose CHORD motion_v1.parquet is the robot-only schema (FlashCHORD loader refuses) are replaced —
#   same triplet full-schema clip, first by name (2), else the next triplet in the seed-42 order with the same rng (8)
# names_sha256 = sha256 of the 64 clip names in this order, one per line (\n-terminated) = 94b43af5631500f8e8cc8165cef172fc91b5612716309313a2bd00ecca21687a
